title: arcPath
body:
## arcPath

Create an editable circular bend path from bend radius and sweep angle, without authoring geometry or constraint indices. The path starts at its frame origin tangent to local+Y, turns counterclockwise and retains native radial construction and endpoint relations. It guides sweeps and does not form a material section.

Native binding: `Sketcher::SketchObject`. Output kind: `["profile"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | one node | yes | `body` |
| `support` | one node | no | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bendRadius` | Positive centreline bend radius in mm, default10. One native named constraint drives the arc radius/centre and both construction radii; use drive.bendRadius for a persistent named length relationship. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `10` |
| `sweepAngle` | Positive counterclockwise turn of1–359degrees, default90, measured in the path frame. The path starts at the frame origin tangent to local+Y. Native angle edits remain editable; angular document drivers are not yet implemented. | `{"type":"number","minimum":1,"maximum":359}` | `90` |
| `origin` | World coordinates [x, y, z] of the circle's centre. For loft sections, offset successive circles along the plane normal (for example origin [0, 0, 30] for the upper section on XY). | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `plane` | World plane containing the circle; its normal is +Z on XY, along −Y on XZ and +X on YZ. Pick the plane perpendicular to the direction you will extrude along or loft through. | `{"type":"enum","values":["XY","XZ","YZ"]}` | `"XY"` |
| `frame` | An independent right-handed sketch frame: origin in world mm, perpendicular unit xAxis and normal, with local Y defined as normal cross xAxis. Use this instead of plane/origin or onFace; it remains a native placement rather than a linked attachment. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"origin":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true},"xAxis":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true},"normal":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true}}}` | omitted |
| `onFace` | Native planar-face attachment intent, paired with support. Select one extreme outward-facing planar face by semantic direction, anchor and offset; ambiguous or missing faces fail. The persisted native support link follows compatible native support edits. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"face":{"type":"enum","values":["top","bottom","right","left","back","front"],"required":true},"position":{"type":"enum","values":["outermost","innermost"],"default":"outermost"},"anchor":{"type":"enum","values":["projectOrigin","centroid"],"default":"projectOrigin"},"offset":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000,"default":0}}}` | omitted |
